items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.recommendation: Approve Minutes dated June 3, 2025

items.title: Approval of City Attorney Invoices for the Month of May 2025
items.recommendation: Approve invoices in the amount of $114,928.50

items.title: Storm Water Management Facilities Covenant and Agreement
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to approve the Storm Water Management WQMP/BMP Facilities Covenant and Agreement for Plot Plan PP2024-0032, Beaumont Library Expansion.

items.title: Accept Public Improvements and Exonerate Maintenance Bond
items.recommendation: Accept the public improvements, authorize the Mayor to sign the Certificate of Acceptance, and authorize staff to issue a bond exoneration letter for maintenance bonds for (Project / Receipt Number / Improvement): Tract Map No. 31462 PH 4A / 1001191180 / Storm Drain Improvements

items.title: Fiscal Year 2024 City of Beaumont, California Multiple Species Habitat Conservation Plan Agreed Upon Procedures Report
items.recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Agreed Upon Procedures Report for the MSHCP Fees Compliance Review for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024.

items.title: Approval of a Lease Agreement with Riverside County Office of Economic Development for Pass Area Biz Hub – 514 California Avenue
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to execute the lease agreement with the Riverside County Office of Economic Development for the use of office space within the Pass Area Biz Hub and to take all necessary actions to facilitate operations.

items.title: Second Reading to Adopt Ordinance Establishing Fire Hazard Severity Zones within Local Responsibility Areas in the City of Beaumont
items.recommendation: Waive the second full reading and adopt by title only: “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Adopting the Fire Hazard Severity Zones as Recommended by the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection Pursuant to Government Code Section 51178”

items.title: Resolution to Adopt the FY24 Justice Assistance Grant (JAG)
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, authorizing certain city officials of the City of Beaumont or designee to accept the Fiscal Year 2024 Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) award in the amount of eleven thousand one hundred forty-two dollars ($11,142), and to authorize all documents in the furtherance thereof.”

items.title: Approve Contract With PetData
items.recommendation: Approve the service contract with PetData to provide animal license processing services.

items.title: Follow-Up Report No. 7 – Local State of Emergency – Sewer Mainline Failure and Emergency Repairs in Fairway Canyon
items.recommendation: Direct staff to return at the next Council meeting with a follow-up report on environmental permits.

items.title: Second Amendment to Professional Services Agreement with Omni Pro, Inc.
items.recommendation: Approve the Second Amendment to the Agreement with Omni Pro Inc. to extend the term to June 30, 2026.

items.title: 2025 ICSC Las Vegas Conference
items.recommendation: Receive and file.

items.title: Development Agreement by and between the City of Beaumont and Beaumont Regency AVG LLC (PLAN2025-0177)
items.recommendation: Conduct Public Hearing and then: Waive the first full reading and adopt by title only, “An Ordinance (Attachment E) of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Approving a Development Agreement (Attachment F) by and between the City of Beaumont and Beaumont Regency AVG LLC” and making findings that the Development Agreement is exempt from CEQA in accordance with Section 15183 of the CEQA Guidelines. Adopt Resolution of the City Council (Attachment G) approving the Off-Site Traffic Improvements Reimbursement Agreement to be effective only with the Development Agreement. Adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council (Attachment H) approving Amending the Five-Year Capital Improvement Plan for Fiscal Years 2025-2029” to include the Maximum Reimbursement Amount of $6 million from the Streets & Bridges Development Impact Fee Account.

items.title: Tentative Tract Map 38879 (TM2023-0012) and Variance (V2025-0024) for Consideration of a Proposed Subdivision Located West of Pennsylvania Avenue and North of Eleventh Street in the Residential Single-Family Zone (APN: 415-200-031)
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; Approve Tentative Tract Map No. 38879 (TM2023-0012) subject to the conditions of approval and approve V2025-0024 to allow for lot depths to exceed 2.5 times the width; and Direct staff to prepare a Notice of Exemption for the Applicant to file with the Riverside County Clerk Recorder.

items.title: PLAN 2025-0204 Public Hearing to Consider a Resolution Repealing the Noble Creek Vistas Specific Plan
items.recommendation: Hold a Public Hearing; and Waive the full reading and adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Repealing the Noble Creek Vistas Specific Plan”; and Direct Staff to prepare a Notice of Exemption and file with the Riverside County Clerk Recorder and the State Clearinghouse.

items.title: Public Hearing to Consider Amending the City’s Fee Schedule to Add Vendor Registration Fees for Special Events Hosted by the City
items.recommendation: Hold a Public Hearing, and Waive the full reading and Adopt by Title Only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Amending the City’s Fee Schedule and Approving the Addition of a New Deposit Based Registration Fee for Vendor Participation in Special Events Hosted by the City”.

items.title: Annual Resolution to Place the Levy of Special Taxes for Community Facilities Districts on the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Riverside County Tax Roll
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Levying the Special Tax in Community Facilities Districts No. 93-1, 2016-1, 2016-2, 2016-3, 2016-4, 2018-1, 2019-1, 2021-1, and 2023-1 and Directing the County Auditor to Collect the Same on the Tax Rolls (93-1, 2016-1, 2016-2, 2016-3, 2016-4, 2018-1, 2019-1, 2021-1, and 2023-1).” Waive the full reading and adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Levying the Special Tax in Community Facilities Districts No. 93-1 (IA 18) and Directing the County Auditor to Collect the Same on the Tax Rolls (IA 18)” Waive the full reading and adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Levying the Special Tax in Community Facilities Districts No. 93-1 (IA 14 and 14B) and Directing the County Auditor to Collect the Same on the Tax Rolls (IA 14 and 14B).” Waive the full reading and adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Levying the Special Tax in Community Facilities Districts No. 93-1 (IA 9) and Directing the County Auditor to Collect the Same on the Tax Rolls (IA 9).” Waive the full reading and adopt by title only “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Levying the Special Tax in Community Facilities Districts No. 93-1 (IA 8E) and Directing the County Auditor to Collect the Same on the Tax Rolls (IA 8E).”

items.title: Adaptive Management and Mitigation Plan (AMMP) Update - Provide Direction on the Quantity of Recycled Water to Pursue – Capital Improvement Project No. WW-14
items.recommendation: Direct staff to pursue Scenario 1, reduction of discharge to 1.7 MGD

items.title: Revenue Outlook and Review of Options
items.recommendation: Receive and file the Revenue Outlook and Review of Options report prepared by GrassrootsLab, LLC, and direct staff to proceed with phase 2 outlined above.

items.title: Approval of a Cooperative Agreement with the County of Riverside to Provide One-Time Equipment and Staffing Cost Share Agreement Services for Fire Station #106
items.recommendation: Approve the Cooperative Agreement between the City of Beaumont and the County of Riverside for Fire Station #106 Equipment and Staffing; and Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any related documents.

items.title: Discussion and Direction on Rescinding Purchase Order No. 24/252033 in the Amount of $1,383,753 Issued to the County of Riverside for a Fire Engine Smeal Type 1 Apparatus – Capital Improvement Project No. PS25-05
items.recommendation: Staff recommends City Council rescind Purchase Order No. 24/252033 and direct staff to notify the County of Riverside to include the new fire engine in the engine use agreement, ensuring its assignment to the City of Beaumont.

items.title: 2025 Pavement Management Program (PMP) Update
items.recommendation: Approve the 2025 Pavement Management Program Update and Scenario 1 of the PMP Update to align with the current Street Rehabilitation funding in the adopted FY26 - FY30 Capital Improvement Plan (CIP).

items.title: First Amendment to Agreement with NV5 for Plan Checking and Inspection Services
items.recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to execute the First Amendment of the Professional Services Agreement to NV5, Inc., in an amount not to exceed $365,000 for FY25.

items.title: Discussion of the City’s Parking Citation Fees
items.recommendation: Discuss and direct staff to bring a public hearing back for Council consideration.

items.title: Beaumont Transit Yard Update
items.recommendation: Receive and file an update for the Beaumont Transit Yard.

items.title: Legislative Update Discussion – June 2025
items.recommendation: Receive and file. These bills fall within the adopted 2025 Legislative Platform.
